cohort: 180 frozen admin IDs, 66 public GitHub archive copies, 13 response observed
selection: Public archivable subset only; outcome response and final signature counts from retrospective archive (leakage for any early-date forecast)

features.M0: Mean response prevalence from 65 training petitions, leave-one-ID-out
features.M1: Legal threshold eligibility as deterministic signature_count>=10000 (full retrospective count) and no model fitting
features.M2: Ridge regularized logistic regression on log(1+final signatures), leave-one-ID-out, 1800 GD updates on standardized training feature

reference_rule_scope: The 10,000 threshold is a known administrative rule. Perfect apparent match is not a scientific discovery or prospective forecast.
specification: univariate logistic, intercept and slope ridge penalties 0.02 and 0.03, iterations 1800, step 0.2, no person or political score
